text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, invited by Biko Pegasus, I 
visited a restaurant that was used for 
filming Carrotman.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! This is it! The thing 
Carrotman was eating!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The "Omega Big Burger"! Whoa, that looks 
so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? They even have the pancakes Radishman 
was eating! Gotta order these too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! We get to eat the exact 
same menu as Carrotman and the crew, you 
know!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Since I came all this way, I wanna eat 
everything that everyone else was having!
choice_data_list: I'll help out with that too.
I'll help out with that too!
Got it! Eat as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Since I came all this way, I wanna eat 
everything that everyone else was having!
choice_data_list: I'll help out with that too.
I'll help out with that too!
Got it! Eat as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see! If you're coming along, Trainer, we 
can order tons of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to order! Let's show 'em 
the power of a hero tag team!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, delicious! The Omega Big Burger is 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's recreate that scene! 
Trainer, you're Radishman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...What's the matter, Radishman? You've 
got an unusually happy look on your face."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahahahaha! You're not like them 
at all, but this is fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed a meal together with 
Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Thanks, Trainer! All right! I'm 
gonna eat a whole bunch today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! We'd like to order!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Yes! Are you ready to order?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Umm... an Omega Big Burger, and maple 
pancakes, and a Margherita pizza, and 
French fries, and a whole roasted chicken, 
and—
choice_data_list: ...Can you actually eat all of that!?
...Can you actually eat all of that!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I ate... so much... I can't eat 
another bite...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Biko Pegasus muttered those words, 
about half of the food was still left on 
her plate.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'll leave the rest to you... 
*collapses*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although you ended up finishing what she 
couldn't eat, Biko Pegasus relished the 
food to her heart's content.
